_README: Every environment name this Worker reads, and what each one is for.
WHY A REGISTER RATHER THAN A GREP. Most bindings are read as `env.SOMETHING` and a scan finds
them. Provider credentials are not: `credentialValueFor(env, providerKey)` looks the name up at
runtime from src/shared/ai/providerCredentials.ts, so `WP_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` appears nowhere as
a property access and is invisible to every text search. A name that nothing can see is a name
nobody sets, and an unset credential is a lane that is enabled and broken.
`npm run validate:env-vars` fails when this file and src/worker/env.ts disagree in either
direction, and when a vendor is added to the credential map without being declared as a binding.
NO VALUE IS EVER RECORDED HERE. Names and purposes only.

WP_OS_DOCUMENTS.purpose: R2 — governed binary documents. Absent degrades cleanly.

WP_OS_KV.purpose: KV — ephemeral config and cache only, never institutional truth.

AI.purpose: Workers AI — the cheap tier, and the only free lane whose terms do not permit training.

BROWSER.purpose: Browser Rendering (P44). A binding, so no egress exemption and no third-party credential.

EMAIL.purpose: Cloudflare Email Sending. Commented out in wrangler.toml; Resend carries outbound mail.

WP_OS_ENV.purpose: local | preview | production. Gates the dev identity header.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.purpose: OpenRouter — the primary lane, and until 17 Sep 2026 the only one. Every ACTIVE model sat behind it.

OPENAI_API_KEY.purpose: OpenAI direct. Reached only when the primary fails, as the same model.

WP_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.purpose: Anthropic direct. WP_-prefixed deliberately: the owner's vault treats the bare ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as reserved, alongside ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK, PATH and LD_PRELOAD, because emitting it into a process environment would hijack her own Claude tooling. Do not rename it.

GEMINI_API_KEY.purpose: Google Gemini, paid and unpaid quota. Unrelated to GOOGLE_OAUTH_*, which is the calendar client.

PERPLEXITY_API_KEY.purpose: Perplexity direct — the only fallback search has. Speaks /v1/responses, not chat-completions.

FIREWORKS_API_KEY.purpose: Fireworks. No key exists; the provider stays disabled until one does.

AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY.purpose: The name every vendor but OpenRouter and Fireworks used to share. Kept as a fallback so an environment configured before the per-vendor names existed keeps working; no vendor is REPORTED as using it any more.

HARVEY_API_KEY.purpose: Specialist legal lane (P23). No vendor account exists; a name only.

NORM_API_KEY.purpose: Specialist lane (P23). No vendor account exists; a name only.

RUNWARE_API_KEY.purpose: Image generation. Absent means the capability is off, not broken.

CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.purpose: Access service token, read only by the browser client and only for this firm's own hosts.

CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.purpose: The other half of that token. The Worker's own auth never reads it.

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.purpose: Read-only calendar client (P51). One client for the firm; each partner grants their own account.

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.purpose: The other half of the calendar client.

WP_OS_NETWORK_OS_SESSION_SECRET.purpose: Signs the wpn_session cookie Network OS accepts (P35).

WP_OS_EMAIL_SEND.purpose: Literal "enabled" switches sending on. Anything else, unset included, keeps it recorded-only.

WP_OS_EMAIL_FROM.purpose: Verified sender address. Without it a send is refused rather than guessed.

WP_OS_AI_EMAIL_PARTNERS.purpose: Whether an AI employee may email the Managing Partners. Off unless exactly "enabled".

WP_OS_AI_EMAIL_EXTERNAL.purpose: Whether an AI employee may email outside the firm. The one with no undo.

WP_OS_PARTNER_EMAIL_DOMAIN.purpose: Domain the partners' addresses live on. A derived list, not a hard-coded one.

WP_OS_NETWORK_OS_BASE_URL.purpose: Network OS origin (P35). All three Network OS names are required before the pull works.

WP_OS_NETWORK_OS_USER_EMAIL.purpose: The identity Network OS authenticates; must be on its own approved-users list.

WP_OS_CLAIMER_CLIENT_ID.purpose: Access service token client id of the subscription-seat claimer on the owner's Mac (migration 0187). A NAME, not a secret: Access verifies both halves at the edge and forwards only a signed assertion. Absent means the claimer identity does not exist and the subscription lanes can never be claimed — safe, not broken: the chain answers every run on the lanes it always used.

WP_OS_GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.purpose: Service-account JSON with domain-wide delegation over the firm calendar (Phase Meet). Vault name GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON, aliased by cloudflare-mapping.json. Read only by effects/googleWorkspaceClient.ts.

WP_OS_CAL_ICS_WESTPEEK.purpose: Private iCal URL of the firm calendar - the fallback door when the Calendar API path fails. Vault name CAL_ICS_WESTPEEK.

WP_OS_GCP_PROJECT_ID.purpose: GCP project owning the service account, the Meet API enablement and the Pub/Sub topic (gsc-automation-493801). Non-secret.

WP_OS_MEET_PUBSUB_TOPIC.purpose: projects/{p}/topics/{t} that Workspace Events publish Meet events to. Non-secret.

WP_OS_MEET_PUBSUB_SUBSCRIPTION.purpose: projects/{p}/subscriptions/{s} the meet_ingest tick pulls from. Pull, never push: the Worker sits behind Cloudflare Access. Non-secret.
